C0301.title: HTTP Flood Mitigation: A Metadata-Based Detection Approach
C0301.summary: A 2015 IEEE conference paper proposes a metadata monitoring method to defend against HTTP GET flood attacks. Attackers use botnets to exhaust server resources with massive volumes of legitimate-looking HTTP GET requests. The approach identifies IP addresses with anomalous request frequencies through real-time big data analytics and maintains normal service even under 9 Gbps attack traffic.

references.title: Mitigating HTTP flooding attacks with meta-data analysis
